changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillinginvoiceitem AS SELECT bii.id, bii.invoice_id, bii.nurse_service_product_id, bii.code, bii.quantity, bii.unit_price, bii.total_price, bii.currency, bii.created_by, bii.created_date, bii.last_modified_by, bii.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_invoice_item bii;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillinginvoiceitem TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillinginvoiceitem FROM report_user;
